daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Volatility Rankings with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate the 30-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns for each stock using window functions. Rank stocks by volatility within each month using ROW_NUMBER() and RANK(). Create a CTE to identify the top 10 most volatile stocks in the last quarter. Expected output: a table showing stock symbol, month, volatility rank, 30-day rolling std dev, and trading volume. Use LAG() to calculate daily percentage returns.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data and clean it thoroughly: handle missing values in severity columns, standardise datetime formats, remove duplicates, and validate coordinate data. Engineer new features: time of day categories (early morning, peak hour, night), day of week groupings (weekday vs weekend), and crash severity risk scores. Create a summary report showing crash frequency by region, time period, and severity. Output cleaned data to CSV with data quality metrics (% missing, % duplicates, rows processed).

daily_quests.title: Great Barrier Reef Monitoring Dashboard Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a data pipeline: (1) Use Python/pandas to fetch and clean Great Barrier Reef monitoring data (coral bleaching events, temperature anomalies, biodiversity metrics). Handle missing dates, validate temperature ranges, and aggregate by reef zone. (2) Load cleaned data into a SQLite database. (3) Write SQL queries to calculate 12-month moving averages of bleaching events, year-over-year change in coral health metrics, and identify high-risk zones (using window functions). (4) Generate a summary: which zones show most improvement/decline, what's the correlation between temperature anomaly and bleaching events? Output: cleaned CSV, SQLite schema diagram, and a final summary report with top 3 findings.
